description:
Combine specific screens from different products, plus one visual style, into a single build
brief. Each screen contributes one thing (say what with "id: what to take"); structure comes from
the screens and every visual token comes from the chosen style, so conflicting looks are resolved
instead of mixed. Returns the brief as Markdown with the screenshots attached. When the screens
contain interactive components (modals, tabs, toggles, toasts, forms), the brief also lists
matching entries from the motion library to fetch with getMotion.

Use this when the user wants, say, Linear's issue composer, Vercel's pricing layout and Notion's
visual language in one screen. Find screen ids with searchScreens or findRelatedScreens first.
For one product's whole flow or collection, use buildHandoff instead.

goal.description: What you want to build. Goes at the top of the brief.

screens.description: 1 to 6 screen ids, each optionally followed by ": what to take from it", e.g. ["linear-product-new-issue: issue composer modal", "vercel-marketing-pricing: plan cards and FAQ"].

stack.description: Preferred stack, e.g. Next.js and Tailwind.

style.description: Product id whose measured visual language to use, e.g. linear or stripe. Omit to use the project's own design system.

styleContext.description: Which of the style product's guides to use. Defaults to marketing when most screens are marketing pages, otherwise product.

styleNotes.description: Extra visual direction in words, e.g. "our brand green #1a7f37, rounded corners". Used on its own when style is omitted.

name: build_recipe

images.description: Preview URLs of up to four references

prompt.description: Markdown brief to follow or paste into an agent.

title: Build a reference recipe
